module.name: table
module.description: A Markdown table with its formatting as arguments: text size, row padding, columns kept on one line, a bold key column, column widths, the best value of a column in bold, highlighted rows, and names on the rows for narration cues. Body = the table (a paragraph before or after it is set as a small caption).
module.aiSpec:
A TABLE with its formatting given as arguments — instead of an @addstyle block with `th, td { font-size … padding … } td:first-child { white-space: nowrap }` around it. Body: a Markdown table as usual (math in cells as \( … \)). A paragraph in the body before or after the table is set as a small, muted caption / note (e.g. the setting of the data, a unit).
Parameters (all optional): • size (number) — the cells' text size in em, e.g. 0.85 (the theme's is about 0.75). • pad (number) — padding above and below the cell text, in em, e.g. 0.2 (tight). • padx (number) — padding left and right of the cell text, in em. • nowrap (list of column numbers, e.g. [1] or [1, 3]; `all`) — those columns are kept on one line (no 標準誤／差 break). • key (boolean) — the first column is bold and kept on one line (a row label). • widths (list of % per column, e.g. [30, 40, 30]) — column widths; the table then takes the full width. width (text, e.g. 70%) — the table's own width. • best (list of COL:max / COL:min, e.g. [3:max, 4:min]) — the best number of those columns is set in bold (ties too), computed from the cells — no hand-written **. • hl (list of body-row numbers, e.g. [2]) — those rows are tinted (the row being discussed, the row picked in a lookup). • rows (text) — a name prefix: the body rows become places PREFIX1, PREFIX2 … for cues — [[look: row:#PREFIX2]] (the row), [[look: #PREFIX2]] (its first cell). No \focus to write in the first cells. • tag (text) — the whole table as #TAG.
Example: <!-- @table size: 0.85, pad: 0.2, key: true, best: [3:max], rows: m --> 電池 10 本の寿命（時間） | 方法 | 自由度 | 棄却した回数 | |---|:---:|:---:| | 前回の方法 | 4 | 16 | | 2 群の \(t\) 検定 | 8 | 6 | <!-- @end -->

param.name: size
param.label: Text size (em)
param.desc: The cells' text size, e.g. 0.85 (blank = the theme's).

param.name: pad
param.label: Row padding (em)
param.desc: Padding above and below the cell text, e.g. 0.2 (blank = the theme's).

param.name: padx
param.label: Side padding (em)
param.desc: Padding left and right of the cell text (blank = the theme's).

param.name: nowrap
param.label: One-line columns
param.desc: Column numbers kept on one line, e.g. 1 or 1, 3 or all.

param.name: key
param.label: Key column
param.desc: The first column bold and on one line.

param.name: widths
param.label: Column widths (%)
param.desc: Width of each column in %, e.g. [30, 40, 30].

param.name: width
param.label: Table width
param.desc: The table's width, e.g. 70% (blank = the theme's).

param.name: best
param.label: Best values
param.desc: COL:max or COL:min per column, e.g. [3:max, 4:min] — set in bold.

param.name: rows
param.label: Row names
param.desc: A prefix: body rows become places PREFIX1, PREFIX2 … (row:#PREFIX1).

snippet.label: Table (size, padding, key column, row names)
snippet.description: Formatting as arguments instead of @addstyle; rows become #r1, #r2 … for cues.
